name: snakeball
description: Snakeball — a simple, addictive casual endless runner for iOS, Android and Apps in Toss.

scripts.sync:public: rm -rf public && mkdir -p public && cp index.html public/index.html && cp -R static/. public/
scripts.deploy:web: npm run sync:public && firebase deploy --only hosting && npm run deploy:rules
scripts.check: npm run check:skins && npm run check:economy && npm run check:road && npm run check:listing
